notes.note: Reviewed explicit product-only restore fence source and actual consumers: finite argv validation, existing private credential admission, schema-asserting admission-serialized transaction, source revocation and cache invalidation, no migrate/listener/timer path, bounded owned qualifier process and exact receipt. No-argument serving and HTTP/personal/publisher authority remain unchanged.28 focused broker tests and broker typecheck passed. Maintained livePG qualifiers atb502/bac51/ae54 passed; final ae54 includes ten entrypoint schema-corruption refusals, first/repeat fence1/0, active-to-refused source probe and fingerprints of observations/migrations/publisher keys/Lite sources/noise/publications. Actual frozen bac51 image fenced the retained old snapshot that previously accepted a post-snapshot revoked key: one-shot1 then0, all non-source table digests and prior revoked timestamps unchanged; normal new-image receiver storage-ready,2 observations retained, old copied key401. Both projects stopped. This establishes product-source invalidation only; publisher reconciliation, managed restore/install orchestration, personal sync, native and qualified release remain unfinished. Module-map/monitoring normal-flow claims remain accurate; operator command details live in the receiver and deployment guides. No baseline advancement.
